description: Lightweight SQLite utilities using stdlib sqlite3: connect (context manager with WAL, foreign keys, auto commit/rollback), query_all and query_one (return plain dicts), bulk_insert (multi-row INSERT with conflict resolution), and migrate (version-tracked schema migrations). No dependencies beyond the standard library.

library_notes.general: Single responsibility — one widget does one thing. No global state. No project-specific code, hardcoded paths, credentials, or environment-specific values. Expose variation points as constructor parameters or function arguments — no hardcoded thresholds, colors, sizes, or behavior flags. All dependencies must be declared in widget.json tech_stack.dependencies. Examples must run and exit cleanly with no user input, no network calls, and no external dependencies. Do not modify library_notes — it is managed by Cartograph and will be restored on checkin.
library_notes.language: Use pytest for all tests — no unittest. Type hints required on all public functions. No __init__.py in tests/. No if __name__ == '__main__' blocks in src/ files. Imports ordered: stdlib, third-party, local.
